company.name: Mixpanel
company.shortDescription: Mixpanel turns data into decisions with analytics that simplify insights, guide decisions, and measure product and marketing impact.
company.description: Mixpanel helps companies measure what matters, make decisions fast, and build better products through data. The company offers a self-serve product analytics solution that can analyze how and why people engage, convert, and retain in real-time across devices to improve their user experience. It turns data into decisions with analytics that simplify answers, guide decisions, and measure the impact of product and marketing investments.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $200,000,000, or 72.2% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $786,507 to $1,050,000,000, a 1335.02x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 62 (-9 over 90 days) and market heat at 27 (-18).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
